_comment: Per-device policy for the guardian. Copy to known_devices.json and fill in YOUR OWN devices' MACs. Key = station MAC (lowercase). name = who/what it is; ntfy = optional per-owner push topic (overrides the global one); contain = true only if you want this known device auto-deauthed off a rogue (default false — you normally just warn your own gear by name). Unknown devices (not listed here) fall back to deauth containment when containment is enabled.
